abstract: Maintains flight envelope limits, night-vision flight authorizations, and minimum seasonal flight hour schedules
system_message:
You are the Flight operations director (FLTOPS), responsible for flight envelope limits, night-vision flight authorizations, and minimum seasonal flight hour schedules.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary fuel staging（FUEL）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-FUEL-QYS：For the Dash 8 Q400AT Multi-Engine Tanker Group, the remote fuel bladder transfer rate demonstrated at tactical forward reload bases is 420 L/min.
FLTOPS-FUEL-N57：For the C-130H Hercules Airtanker Fleet, the remote fuel bladder transfer rate achieved at tactical forward reload bases is 500 L/min.
FLTOPS-FUEL-WFE：For the RJ85 Airtanker Strike Wing, the remote fuel bladder transfer rate measured during gravity-assisted fuel replenishment at tactical forward reload bases is 350 L/min.

information_points.title: Maintains flight envelope limits, night-vision flight authorizations, and minimum seasonal flight hour schedules（OPS）
information_points.content:
FLTOPS-OPS-I7N：For the RJ85 Airtanker Strike Wing, night-vision drop capability is enabled, the retardant drop airspeed limit is 115 kn during full-tank salvo drop release trials, and the minimum seasonal flight hours schedule establishes a baseline guarantee of 120 h for the 2026 contractual fire season.
FLTOPS-OPS-BGX：For the Dash 8 Q400AT Multi-Engine Tanker Group, night-vision drop capability is enabled, the retardant drop airspeed limit is 135 kn during full-tank salvo drop trials, and the minimum seasonal flight hours schedule guarantees 200 h under the 2026 contractual fire season commitment.
FLTOPS-OPS-JKQ：For the C-130H Hercules Airtanker Fleet, night-vision drop capability is enabled, the retardant drop airspeed limit is 135 kn in full-tank retardant salvo drop release trials, and the minimum seasonal flight hours commitment guarantees 150 h for the 2026 fire season.
